THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BARON, ZALAMAN BARON, LUDMILA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HUDSON, KATHLEEN COLLINS, DONNA J. THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 170 COOK STREET #3 SAN FRANCISCO, CA., STAYED UNTIL JUN-01-2003, LEASE FORFEITED, SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT. IF DEFENDANTS VACATE THE PREMISE BY 6/1/03, NO BACK RENT DUE. IF NOT, PLAINTIFF TO HAVE AMENDED JUDGMENT FOR $2,300. BACK RENT AND UNLAWFUL DETAINER DAMAGES OF $76.66 PER DAY FROM 5/1/03 THROUGH 6/1/03, NO ATTORNEY FEES, AND COST OF $337.00 FOR A TOTAL AMENDED JUDGMENT OF $5, 013.46. SEE SCANNED DOC FOR AADDITIONAL DETAILS. NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT AND AFFIDAVIT OF MAILING FILED
